Game Overview

Nuts Bolts Screw Glass is a puzzle title where dive into a world of physics-based puzzles where strategic thinking rules. Unscrew bolts to provoke mesmerizing chain reactions that send gears spinning and glass targets shattering. Analyze, predict, and execute the perfect sequence in hundreds of challenging levels. Embrace the art of disassembly and experience the thrill of precision.
